mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id AND ur.tenant_id = u.tenant_id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id WHERE u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.id = #{userId} AND u.status = 'ENABLED' AND u.deleted = 0 AND r.role_code = 'PLATFORM_ADMIN' AND r.built_in = 1 AND r.status = 'ENABLED' AND r.deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET auth_version = auth_version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE sys_user SET deleted = 1, auth_version = auth_version + 1, updated_by = #{auditorId}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
